newsitem.title: USA: Payless ShoeSource Oct sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Payless ShoeSource Oct sales rise.

text.p: Payless ShoeSource Inc said on Thursday that same-store sales for the four weeks ended November 2 rose 9.3 percent from a year ago.
Total October sales rose six percent, to $165.4 million from $156.0 million.
Year-to-date, Payless same-store sales rose 3.9 percent, and total sales gained 1.8 percent to $1.81 billion.

During October, Payless opened 14 new stores and closed 15 old ones as a part of a previously announced program to shutter underperforming units. At the end of October, it operated 4,264 stores, compared with 4,582 a year ago.
Sales comparisons for October and the first nine months of the fiscal year were affected by a one-week shift in reporting periods, Payless said.
On an adjusted basis, same-store sales rose 9.9 percent for the four weeks ended November 2 and rose 3.3 percent for the nine months.
